part.text:
All tests pass and the build compiles cleanly.

## Summary

Added Handlebars template/layout/partial support to the static site generator.

**New file `src/templates.ts`** — `TemplateEngine` class:
- Resolves page templates from `./templates/`, layouts from `./templates/layouts/`, and partials from `./templates/partials/` (`.hbs` / `.handlebars`).
- Built-in default template (`{{{body}}}` pass-through) and default layout (replicating the old page wrapper) preserve existing output when no templates directory exists.
- Partials are auto-registered by filename (`header`, `footer`, `nav` → `{{> header}}`).

**`src/index.ts`** — integrated the engine:
- `Frontmatter` now supports `template` and `layout` (with `layout: false` to skip the wrapper).
- `BuildOptions` gained `templatesDir`, `defaultTemplate`, `defaultLayout`.
- Page context exposes frontmatter, `title`/`date`/`tags`, `content`/`body`, `slug`, and `site.pages` for nav.

**Tests** — added `src/templates.test.ts` (10 new tests) covering layouts, custom templates, partials, default template file, `layout: false`, custom frontmatter fields, and HTML escaping semantics.
